olivia (eng-releases): Quick heads-up — planning to enable nova-13b-v2 in the model catalog during the 02:00 UTC change window tomorrow. Need a quick sync on priority slotting and fallback ordering. TL;DR: avoid thrash with current quant variants.

sam (eng-runtime): Ack. Do we want a strict slot priority (1..N) or weight-based routing for the first 24h?

olivia (eng-releases): Prefer strict slot priority for initial rollout — simpler to reason about when we trigger pins/rollbacks. Can switch to weights after warm-up.

derrick (eng-sre): From SRE side: keep the rollback leash tight. If p50 latency > 1.2s or error rate spike > 0.5% for 5m, auto-fallback to prior variant. Can deploy-bot enforce that? @deploy-bot

deploy-bot: scheduled window reserved: 2026-03-22 02:00:00 UTC -> 2026-03-22 04:00:00 UTC. Canary traffic: 5% -> 25% -> 100% over 30/60/60m. Health checks: latency_slo=1.2s, error_rate_slo=0.5%.

leah (eng-platform): Re: slotting — suggest pin order: 1) nova-13b-v2 (fp16-qat) 2) nova-13b-v2-quant (int8) 3) nova-13b-v1 (stable). That gives a fallback chain with decreasing performance. Also set eviction TTL=10m for canary pins.

maya (oncall): If we see KV-cache thrashing on the new model, prefer rolling fallback to v2-quant rather than full revert. Need a manual rollback button mapped in console.

sam (eng-runtime): I'll add the pin+fallback policy to the rollout config. Proposed snippet: 
```
/catalog/enable --model nova-13b-v2 --canary 5,25,100 --slot-priority "nova-13b-v2,nova-13b-v2-quant,nova-13b-v1" --evict-ttl 600
```
Would that work with deploy-bot?

deploy-bot: command accepted. Preparing deploy plan. Will run dry-run checks: compatibility, memory footprint, kernel selection matrix. Dry-run ETA: 40m.

olivia (eng-releases): Two operational asks: 1) add a short release note in console mentioning expected perf delta and known regressions (none expected) 2) tag support rotation: sam + maya for first 3 hours, leah on standby.

leah (eng-platform): Noted. I'll wire the rollback button to a pre-approved runbook: `rb:catalog-revert nova-13b-v2->nova-13b-v1` and add the canary escalation page.

derrick (eng-sre): One more: set fallback ordering TTL to 2h after full rollout, then reduce to soft-fallback (weights) if stable. We don't want the system to keep falling back indefinitely.

olivia (eng-releases): Sounds good. If deploy-bot dry-run passes, we'll proceed with the scheduled window. Anyone object?

sam (eng-runtime): No objections. I'll post the rollout note and pin the config in the catalog.

maya (oncall): I'll be on watch for the first canary step. Ping me @maya if deploy hits >0.3% errors.

olivia (eng-releases): Great — thanks all. Leaving this thread open for any last-minute blockers. :rocket:
